source_name: State Revenue Committee (KGD) — taxpayer search / published lists
organization: State Revenue Committee, Ministry of Finance (kgd.gov.kz)

fields.meaning: Business Identification Number (legal entities) or Individual Identification Number (individuals).
fields.limitations: 12-digit. Browser-public search; join key (BIN) to gbd_ul.
fields.analysis_notes: BIN for legal entities; IIN for individuals.

fields.limitations: Individuals are personal data — redact individuals.

fields.meaning: VAT (НДС) registration status of the taxpayer.
Taxpayer status (active / inactive / pseudo-enterprise / debtor — per the relevant published list).
fields.limitations: Status comes from specific KGD lists; tax status, not registration status.
fields.analysis_notes: KGD publishes lists: inactive, pseudo-enterprise, tax-debtors, deregistered, VAT payers.
